## Background

You are excited for your new job in the Strategy Department at Boeing, a commercial airliner manufacturer in the United States. In an effort to better understand their customer’s operations, Boeing is curious about how the age of an airplane affects its use. In a previous analysis ([Age of Planes](http://localhost:3332/Task_17_age_of_planes.html)) you investigated the age of airplanes. Senior level managers found the analysis fascinating and would like to include the charts in a dashboard they are building for the VP of Sales.

They have asked you to polish your charts from that analysis and put them all into a single dashboard.

## Task

1.  Build a dashboard that includes the 3 charts you created in the [Age of Planes](http://localhost:3332/Task_17_age_of_planes.html) analysis. The dashboard should include one other image (e.g. a picture of a plane or the Boeing logo) to improve the aesthetic appeal of the dashboard.

    -   You can create this in your docs folder to ensure the .html file is public after you render it

2.  Enable GitHub Pages in the root directory of your main branch. To do this, follow the instructions in the reading. (There are other ways to enable GitHub Pages that are better if you are actually going to build an entire website, but for this one-off type document this is the simplest way to get introduced to the idea of hosting webpages from GitHub).

### Submit

In I-learn submit a link to your dashboard .html file published on your repo’s GitHub pages.
:::
